brief: The viewer observes a continuous river of patterned material passing through a mechanical printing press. The material flows with patterned streaks of color and texture. When the movement momentarily halts, the viscous ink streaks crystalize into intricate, geometric patterns. These crystallized forms overlap and coalesce, forming complex, layered fractal lattices that hang suspended in space. The colors shift and intensify as the patterns form, creating a dynamic, shimmering sense of structure emerging from fluid motion.
